meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

copy.tagline: 用Adaptyv API设计蛋白质实验并获取结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计蛋白质实验并获取实验数据
copy.tagline_en: Design protein experiments and retrieve results using Adaptyv API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design protein experiments and retrieve experimental data

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能依据 Adaptyv Bio Foundry API 和 Python SDK 的文档,帮你设计蛋白质实验(结合、热稳定性、表达、荧光等),提交氨基酸序列,并获取约 21 天后的实验结果。
howto.when: 当你提到 Adaptyv、Foundry API、蛋白质结合/筛选实验等关键词,或想提交蛋白质序列做实验表征,或代码中出现 adaptyv、FoundryClient 等导入时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Adaptyv API 提交一个 PD-L1 的 BLI 结合筛选实验。
say.note: 会生成创建实验的代码并解释流程。

say.text: 查一下 Adaptyv 的 thermostability 实验需要哪些参数?
say.note: 会列出实验规格和测量 Tm 的说明。

say.text: 用 FoundryClient 写脚本列出所有 EGFR 靶点。
say.note: 会给出调用 targets.list 的代码。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK to design protein experiments (binding, thermostability, expression, fluorescence), submit sequences, and retrieve results after ~21 days.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding/screening assays, or wants to submit protein sequences; also when code imports adaptyv, FoundryClient, etc.

say_en.text: Help me submit a BLI binding screen for PD-L1 via the Adaptyv API.
say_en.note: Generates code and explains the workflow.

say_en.text: What parameters does an Adaptyv thermostability experiment need?
say_en.note: Lists the spec and Tm measurement details.

say_en.text: Write a FoundryClient script to list all EGFR targets.
